card.name: Zero after 4 or 5 in numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 0 right after a 4 or 5 inside a number, often in legal section numbers (Section 504) or round counts (40 years, 50 people). Also a hyphen or decimal point after a number.

modes.label: Punctuation inside numbers
modes.description: A hyphen or decimal point following digits in a number or cartridge name.
